evidence.observation: Reboiler heater temperature drifts steadily upward 396→399°C while T703 vessel temperature only creeps 58.8→59.3°C, suggesting poor heat transfer / dry or low-level reboiler
Column section temperature declines monotonically 59.6→57.6°C, i.e. separation profile degrading rather than stabilizing
Distillate flow erratic (0.001–1.86) with repeated near-zero readings at k=17–19 then spike to 1.86
Column differential pressure persistently slightly negative (~-0.1 to -0.26 mbar), indicating negligible vapour traffic/boil-up

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler heater duty/setpoint and reflux-drum level trend, plus a composition (GC) sample of distillate and bottoms, to confirm whether boil-up is actually occurring; T701 calibration check to rule out thermocouple issue.
